A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
